column11: ALL OF IT, AND THE REASON IS THAT THE INFLUENZA HALF OF A COMBINATION IS NOT A NEW INFLUENZA MARKET. NCT07890454 is 'A Phase 3, Parallel, Randomized, Modified Double-Blind, Active-Controlled, Multi-Arm Study to Assess the Safety and Immunogenicity of a Combination Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) Recombinant Spike and High-Dose Inactivated Influenza Vaccine With Matrix-M Adjuvant in Adult Participants 60 Years of Age and Older' (Sanofi, study VBT00004, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-11-14). Its control arm is 'IIV-HD and NVXC19 co-administered in opposite deltoid muscles' and its experimental arm is the same two antigens in one injection. Every participant in both arms receives a high-dose influenza vaccination. The readout decides whether the two antigens travel in one syringe or two - a COVID-19 franchise question and a convenience question - not whether an additional person is vaccinated against influenza. The influenza doses are inside Sanofi's reported Fluzone revenue in either arm. The primary endpoints say the same thing: 'Geometric mean (GMT) of antibody titers measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI)' at Day 28 for influenza and a pseudovirus neutralisation titre for SARS-CoV-2, both non-inferiority immunobridging rather than an incremental population
column12: THREE THINGS THE BOOK HAS WRONG ON THIS ROW AND A HUMAN SHOULD FIX. (1) IT IS NOT A US READOUT. The two sites are in POLAND (Wroclaw and Gdynia) and the comparator is named 'NVXC19 (EU licensed, standalone)'. This book's pools and prices are US. (2) THE INFLUENZA COMPONENT IS NOT IDENTIFIED AS FLUZONE. The registry record names it only as 'IIV-HD'; the strings 'Fluzone' and 'Efluelda' appear nowhere in it. Mapping this trial to the Fluzone asset is an inference the record does not support, and the age window argues against it: the study enrols from 60 where US Fluzone High-Dose is licensed from 65. (3) THE FLU COMPONENT IS TRIVALENT ('Antibody titers against for each of the 3 influenza vaccine strains'), while three of the five brand names on this book row are quadrivalent presentations. If the mapping is corrected, this layer disappears rather than changing value
